Title: [LSJ] Reality Mirror vs. clan-requiring combat cards

Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
Can you play Reality Mirror to strike with a Khabar: Honor (requiring
an Assamite to play) from your opponent's controller's ash heap?

I guess the card does not override clan requirements.

Greetings,
Damnans

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. It will not override any requirements (except Discipline
requirements, per card text) - so it also can't be used for the Anarch
combat cards (unless the !Malk has gone Anarch, of course), etc.
